title: A simple hack to massively improve your Meta Ad results
description: A simple hack to massively improve your Meta Ad results
transcript: One hook for your meta video ads is bad, five is okay, 10+ is ideal. And here's why your hook is the most important part of your meta video ads. Your hook is the opening scene, usually combined with the opening line. And it's what convinces people to either stop the scroll and pay attention to your ad or not. And if they don't pay attention to the rest of your ad, you've got no chance of generating a sale, generating a lead, or getting them to take the action that you want them to take. So we will often record our video ads, let's say a couple of different main bodies, but we will add in 10+ hooks for each. It's quick and easy to do. And by changing up that opening scene, changing up the opening line, you can often find combinations that perform much better than the original one you had planned. It also really helps when it comes to overcoming ad fatigue. Instead of having to create a whole load of new ads, you can often just change the hook and you get past the I've seen this before filter. So people are more likely to pay attention to your ad if they've already seen a previous version. So spend more time on your hooks. 10+ for each video ad you create is ideal.
